eps.ov: Ye Qiu is kicked out of his team that he has captained for 8 years due to his unwillingness to take part in marketing and promotion deals making him unvaluable, despite his skills and his 3 straight championship with the team in the first 3 years. He eventually remembers the opening of the new server and walks into an internet cafe near the team headquarters and finds himself starting at the bottom and working at the internet cafe as a night-shift manager.
While the gaming community is stunned by the announcement of Ye Xiu's retirement, Ye Xiu continues to progress in Glory under a pseudonym.

eps.t: The Unspecialized Do As They Please
eps.ov: Ye Xiu's Unspecialized play style surprises both his online allies and opponents.

eps.t: Wild Bosses Are Meant to Be Stolen!
eps.ov: Ye Xiu steals a boss fight win with help from a new player.
Ye Xiu assembles a team to break a dungeon record, while his former professional team suffers a tournament loss.
An embittered former teammate joins Ye Xiu's team to spy on them.
A powerful guild leader interrupts Ye Xiu's training session.
Following a series of duels against professional players, Tang Rou receives an offer to join a famous guild.
While bartering for rare resources, Ye Xiu and his proteges are ambushed by a group of players.
Through his analytical skills, Yu Wenzhou deduces that Lord Grim is Ye Xiu.

eps.t: Using the Right Method to Tell You What Is Considered Brutal
eps.ov: Ye Xiu and friends face off against a mob of angry players with help from a mysterious strategist.

eps.t: 10 Years of Glory, and It Continues
eps.ov: A longtime rival challenges Ye Xiu to a duel.
